title: oxalis dillenii var. piletorum
intro: Oxalis dillenii var. piletorum, commonly known as the False Sorrel, is a species of flowering plant in the Oxalidaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Asia and the Pacific Islands. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include being used as a natural remedy for fever reduction, inflammation, and as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis dillenii var. piletorum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
